HOME_TAGLINE: Play with friends nearby. No account needed.
HOME_START_HINT: Pick a game and invite your friends.
HOME_JOIN_HINT: Find a nearby game or scan an invite.
INVALID_HOST: Enter the IPv4 or IPv6 address shown on your friend’s device.
JOIN_WAIT_HELP: Waiting for the host. You can cancel without losing the address.
JOIN_ROOM_FULL: This game is full. Ask the host if a seat is available.
ROOM_PUBLIC_HELP: Leave the password blank to let nearby friends join without one.
ROOM_HOST_WATCH_HELP: Host without taking a player seat. Leave the password blank for a public room.
ROOM_PASSWORD_REQUIRED: Enter the room password to join or spectate.
ROOM_PLAYER_FULL_WATCH: No player seats are open. You can still spectate.
ROOM_CHOOSE_JOIN_ROLE: Join as a player or just watch. Spectators cannot take a seat in this room.
JOIN_SPECTATORS_UNSUPPORTED: This game does not support spectating.
JOIN_ROLE_LOCKED: You cannot change roles in this room. Choose again in a new room.
INVITE_PASSWORD_REQUIRED: Password protected · Share the room password separately.
JOIN_IN_PROGRESS: This round has already started. Ask the host when you can join.
JOIN_ROOM_CHANGED: That invitation has expired. Find the game again or scan a new code.
JOIN_ROOM_ENDED: This session is no longer available. Leave and join a new game.
JOIN_INCOMPATIBLE: The games or app versions don’t match. Update both devices and try again.
JOIN_TIMEOUT: The host didn’t respond. Check that the game is still open and try again.
JOIN_STORAGE_FAILED: Could not save the game. Free some storage and try again.
JOIN_PACKAGE_FAILED: The download did not pass verification. Try again with a trusted host.
RECONNECT_TIMEOUT: Could not reconnect automatically. Try again while the host is still playing.
HOST_FAILED: Could not open the game on port %d. Close other running games, then try again.
GAME_VIEW_FAILED: Could not open this game. Try reinstalling its package.
EXIT_HOST_TEXT: You’re hosting. Leaving ends this game for everyone.
EXIT_GUEST_TEXT: Leaving gives up your seat. You can’t reconnect to it after leaving.
INVITE_QR_LABEL: QR code to join this game
PROFILE_HELP: Choose the name and character your friends will see.
SETTINGS_HELP: Changes apply immediately on this device.
HOME_HINT: Choose with arrows · Press to enter
LOBBY_HELP: Choose the same game and play on the same local network.
JOIN_HELP: Choose a nearby game or scan an invitation.
ROOM_CREATED: Game started, waiting for a friend · Address: %s
PEER_OFFLINE: Your friend is offline. Waiting to reconnect.
RESUME_GAME_MISMATCH: Select the original game to reconnect.
NO_NETWORK: No IPv4 address found. Check your network.
INSTALLED_MOD: %s is installed and selected. Launch it when you’re ready.
REDUCE_MOTION_HELP: Stop orbiting, scaling and floating. Keep clear static feedback.
SOUND_HELP: Sound effects are not included yet.
CONNECTION_LOST: Disconnected. Reconnect while the host is still running.
EXIT_MATCH_TEXT: Leaving disconnects this game. If the host leaves, the match ends.
LDR_MISSING_NAME_VERSION: A valid game name and version are required.
LDR_PACKAGE_PATH: Package path must match the game ID.
LDR_MISSING_ENTRY: Rules or presentation entry is missing from the file list.
LDR_INVALID_HOST_START: Starting rounds as host requires an SDK 2 fixed-seat game.
LDR_INVALID_SPECTATORS: Invalid spectator settings: specify a guest limit of 1–8 and a listed GDScript view.
LDR_TWO_PLAYERS: Invalid player bounds or session mode. Use two-player, fixed (2–8), or drop-in (1–8) mode.
LDR_RULE_DEPENDENCY: A rules dependency is missing from the file list.
LDR_ZIP_MANIFEST_COUNT: The ZIP must contain exactly one game manifest.
LDR_FILE_MISMATCH: ZIP files do not match the resource list.
LDR_ZIP_NAMESPACE: ZIP contains files outside its namespace.
LDR_ALREADY_LOADED: This game is already loaded. Restart with a separate package.
LDR_MOUNT_ZIP: Failed to mount the ZIP package.
LDR_READ_PACKAGE: Cannot read the selected game package.
LDR_PACKAGE_SIZE: Game packages must be between 1 byte and 16 MB.
LDR_INCOMPLETE_PACKAGE: The game package could not be read completely.
LDR_STORAGE_DIRECTORY: Cannot create the game storage directory.
ERR_NOT_YOUR_TURN: Wait for your friend to finish their turn.
ERR_OCCUPIED: This spot is occupied. Choose another one.
ERR_STALE_REVISION: The game has updated. Choose using the latest state.
ERR_WAITING_PLAYERS: You can play once your friend joins.
ERR_INVALID_ACTION: That action is not available. Choose again.
ERR_ALREADY_CHOSEN: Your choice is in. Waiting for your friend.
ERR_CARD_NOT_OWNED: Choose a card from your own hand.
PICK_GAME_HELP: Pick a game, then invite your friends to play.
ERR_GAME_NOT_FINISHED: This game is still in progress.
SEARCHING_GAMES: Looking for nearby games… Keep devices on the same local network.
NEARBY_GAMES: Nearby games · Select one to join
DISCOVERY_UNAVAILABLE: Local discovery is unavailable. Check network access or join by address.
DOWNLOAD_GAME_DETAILS:
%s · %s
From %s (%s)
Size: %s KB

This game package contains executable code. Download only from a device you trust. After verification, you will join automatically.
PEER_JOIN_FAILED: Could not join. Check the connection and try again.
INVITE_SCAN: On your friend’s device, choose Join game → Scan to join.
INVALID_JOIN_QR: This is not a Star Clash game invitation. Please scan a game QR code.
CAMERA_UNAVAILABLE: Camera unavailable. You can search nearby games or join by address.
CAMERA_PERMISSION_DENIED: Camera access was denied. Allow it in system settings, or search nearby games.
MANUAL_JOIN_HELP: Enter the address and port from your friend’s invitation. We’ll find the right game for you.
NO_NEARBY_GAMES: No nearby games yet. Check that both devices are on the same network, or scan a QR code / join by address.
USER_DEVICE_NAME: Leave empty for device name · up to 32 characters
USER_SAVE_FAILED: Could not save. Please try again.
NO_BLUETOOTH_GAMES: No Bluetooth rooms found. Ask the host to open Invite a friend and allow Bluetooth joining.
BLUETOOTH_PERMISSION: Allow Bluetooth access to find nearby rooms. On Android, scanning may also ask for precise location.
BLUETOOTH_UNAVAILABLE: Bluetooth is unavailable. Check Bluetooth and app permissions, or join over Wi-Fi.
BLUETOOTH_HOST_PERMISSION: Allow Bluetooth or Nearby devices so friends can find this room.
BLUETOOTH_HOST_READY: Ask friends to select the matching code under Join a game → Bluetooth. Keep the app open.
BLUETOOTH_HOST_FAILED: Bluetooth joining couldn't start. Check Bluetooth or invite over Wi-Fi.
BLUETOOTH_NO_CODE: Nearby device · check with the host
